text: he will not be able to extend the tourist visa. if he wants to live here in israel you need to start the partner visa process ( see our guide https://aic.org.il/partner-visa-in-israel-step-by-step-guide-to-your-first-visa/) or if he wants to come every now and then as a tourist, you will need to invite him. its pointless to go to misrad hapnim now to extend the visa, they will very likely not, he needs to leave by 30.08. and you can invite him according to this procedure: https://www.gov.il/en/service/request_for_tourist_visa_b2
